title: Clang-tidy Docker job fails at handle_docker action - transient Docker buildx/registry issue
signature: handle docker action fails at set up docker buildx or docker image handling step|Infrastructure

failed_jobs.name: Docker
failed_jobs.symptom: handle_docker action step fails after 18 seconds at Set up Docker Buildx

key_errors: Job 'Docker' failed at step 'Run ./.github/actions/handle_docker' (step 5) after ~18 seconds
handle_docker action includes 'Set up Docker Buildx' using image from openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io
Logs inaccessible via API (security policy), duration of 18s indicates very early failure in Docker setup
root_cause: The Docker job in the Clang-tidy workflow failed at the 'Run ./.github/actions/handle_docker' step within 18 seconds. No Dockerfile changes were made in PR #37300 (NPUW optimization). The action sets up Docker Buildx using an image from the Azure Container Registry; a transient registry connectivity or image pull issue is the most likely cause. This is supported by the run automatically moving to attempt 2 (already queued), and similar historical patterns (Docker buildx builder boot fails, ACR OAuth token issues) in the investigation database.
recommended_actions: Wait for attempt 2 of the workflow run to complete; it is already running
If attempt 2 also fails, investigate Azure Container Registry connectivity from AKS runner aks-linux-4-cores-16gb-docker-build
Check openvinogithubactions.azurecr.io availability and Docker image moby/buildkit:buildx-stable-1 accessibility
prevention_strategies: Add retry logic in handle_docker action for Docker Buildx setup steps. Monitor ACR availability as an SLA dependency.
historical_context: Previous similar patterns include 'Docker buildx builder boot fails - buildkit image not found in Azure Container Registry' (1 occurrence, 2026-07-15) and 'Docker build fails - Azure Container Registry OAuth token fetch refused' (1 occurrence, 2026-07-15).
